analysis.evidence: אַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה forms the numeral ‘fourteen’. With שָׁנָה ‘year’, the phrase dates Chedorlaomer’s arrival to the fourteenth year.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וּ means ‘and’. The preposition בְּ marks time (‘in’). אַרְבַּע is a feminine singular absolute cardinal numeral forming a compound with עֶשְׂרֵה.
